source.convention: IssueStack field[type] syntax for suggested typed forms; historical unannotated keys preserved.

semantics.object_members: An object may contain any combination of keys with independently declared value types; no sibling keys are required.
semantics.nested_fields: All listed nested keys are optional examples of observed shapes; additional typed keys allowed.
semantics.arrays: Historical arrays retain their observed element types; no forced migration to IssueStack named-object arrays.
semantics.backwards_compatibility: Existing Issue #1 job comments remain unchanged and valid under this registry; no historical rewrite or coerced fields.
semantics.extension: Future types and keys may be added to the registry without obligating their inclusion in any scratchpad.
semantics.separate_content_rules: Any applicable AGENTS.md content and three-scratchpad requirements continue independently of type selection.
